blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Masters, play here; I will content your pains;
Something that's brief; and bid 'Good morrow, general.'

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: Why masters, have your instruments been in Naples,
that they speak i' the nose thus?

blocks.speaker: First Musician
lines: How, sir, how!

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: Are these, I pray you, wind-instruments?

blocks.speaker: First Musician
lines: Ay, marry, are they, sir.

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: O, thereby hangs a tail.

blocks.speaker: First Musician
lines: Whereby hangs a tale, sir?

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: Marry. sir, by many a wind-instrument that I know.
But, masters, here's money for you: and the general
so likes your music, that he desires you, for love's
sake, to make no more noise with it.

blocks.speaker: First Musician
lines: Well, sir, we will not.

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: If you have any music that may not be heard, to't
again: but, as they say to hear music the general
does not greatly care.

blocks.speaker: First Musician
lines: We have none such, sir.

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: Then put up your pipes in your bag, for I'll away:
go; vanish into air; away!

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Dost thou hear, my honest friend?

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: No, I hear not your honest friend; I hear you.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Prithee, keep up thy quillets. There's a poor piece
of gold for thee: if the gentlewoman that attends
the general's wife be stirring, tell her there's
one Cassio entreats her a little favour of speech:
wilt thou do this?

blocks.speaker: Clown
lines: She is stirring, sir: if she will stir hither, I
shall seem to notify unto her.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Do, good my friend. [Exit Clown] [Enter IAGO]
In happy time, Iago.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: You have not been a-bed, then?

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Why, no; the day had broke
Before we parted. I have made bold, Iago,
To send in to your wife: my suit to her
Is, that she will to virtuous Desdemona
Procure me some access.

blocks.speaker: IAGO
lines: I'll send her to you presently;
And I'll devise a mean to draw the Moor
Out of the way, that your converse and business
May be more free.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: I humbly thank you for't. [Exit IAGO]
I never knew
A Florentine more kind and honest.

blocks.speaker: EMILIA
lines: Good morrow, good Lieutenant: I am sorry
For your displeasure; but all will sure be well.
The general and his wife are talking of it;
And she speaks for you stoutly: the Moor replies,
That he you hurt is of great fame in Cyprus,
And great affinity, and that in wholesome wisdom
He might not but refuse you; but he protests he loves you
And needs no other suitor but his likings
To take the safest occasion by the front
To bring you in again.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: Yet, I beseech you,
If you think fit, or that it may be done,
Give me advantage of some brief discourse
With Desdemona alone.

blocks.speaker: EMILIA
lines: Pray you, come in;
I will bestow you where you shall have time
To speak your bosom freely.

blocks.speaker: CASSIO
lines: I am much bound to you.
